Get an internal or built-in object by ID.

This command allows reading built-in objects that may not be accessible
through regular commands. It also supports lifecycle definitions and object
specifications by their ID or ontology name.

  Get a built-in component type
  zqk.test internal get COMP-TYPE-001
  Get a lifecycle definition
  zqk.test internal get backlog_item_lifecycle
  Get an object specification
  zqk.test internal get backlog_item
  Get with JSON output
  zqk.test internal get COMP-TYPE-001 --format json

Usage:
  zqk.test internal get <id> [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
